stem:
Two elements, $\mathbf{V}$ and $\mathbf{W}$, are in adjacent groups in the Periodic Table.

$\mathbf{V}$ reacts with oxygen to form an acidic gas, $\mathbf{X}$. $\mathbf{V}$ forms an anion with formula $\mathbf{VO}_m^-$.

$\mathbf{W}$ reacts with oxygen to form an acidic gas, $\mathbf{Y}$. $\mathbf{W}$ forms an anion with formula $\mathbf{WO}_n^{2-}$.

A solution of $\mathbf{WO}_n^{2-}$ forms a white precipitate with $\text{Ba}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ but shows no visible reaction with $\text{Mg}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: By referring to enthalpy changes, explain why $\mathbf{WO}_n^{2-}$ forms a white precipitate with $\text{Ba}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ but shows no visible reaction with $\text{Mg}^{2+}$.
